title: MoniTor: Exploiting Large Language Models with Instruction for Online Video Anomaly Detection

layout.note: Four vertical lanes, one per clip, each stacking frame, plain caption, scored caption and a class chip at the foot; box heights and starting points are staggered between lanes and the Monitor logo sits above the second lane.

lesson: Repeat one identical stack (input still, intermediate text, final text with score, class chip) across several columns, one per incident type; the repetition shows breadth and real text with a few coloured key words shows what the system actually writes.
